stem.text: An investigation was carried out to see if compound X could improve the thermostability of an enzyme. Thermostable enzymes will function well at high temperatures.
The results of the investigation are shown.

stem.alt: Line graph of enzyme activity in percent against temperature in degrees Celsius from 10 to 70, with a solid curve and a dashed curve labelled experiment 1 with compound X and experiment 2 without compound X.
